lines.text: We dispatch sixty couriers and have five years of billing records in CSVs.
We can handle the CSV migration within thirty days of contract signature.
We need our dispatch fees synced directly to our QuickBooks account.
We will have the accounting sync standard connector live within fourteen days.
What is the expected timeline for full cutover to Brightpath?
We commit to standard go-live implementation within forty-five days.
Can we view live delivery heatmaps across metropolitan corridors?
Let me check if route heatmaps could be added in our upcoming Q3 roadmap.
We will export our driver license and vehicle registry by this Friday.
